title: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
summary: In two controlled antibody lead-optimization campaigns, Claude and researchers identified misleading thermal assay proxies, revised measurements and experimentally improved anti-albumin VHH and anti-mesothelin scFv leads. Small final-lead replicate counts; no mammalian expression, stress testing or clinical validation.

evidence.tested: The two controlled antibody lead-optimization campaigns report measured improvements in affinity, thermal stability and aggregation after the team identified misleading thermal assay proxies. Small final-lead replicate counts; no mammalian expression, stress testing or clinical validation.
evidence.unknown: No independent replication or clinical utility established.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
